bibl.title: A Ninth-century Coptic Tax Refund Document. Reedition of CPR IV 197.
bibl.seg: Lajos Berkes, Alain Delattre & Naïm Vanthieghem, A Ninth-century Coptic Tax Refund Document. Reedition of CPR IV 197.
bibl.note: Reedition of C.P.R. IV, 197, a declaration by which taxpayers confirm that they have received from the local tax collector the money they overpayed for a given fiscal year. (Region of) Shmoun, ca. 865/866 (?). - Appendix: Another qusṭāl in a Coptic letter (edition of P. Heid. Inv. Kopt. 165 [(Region of) Shmoun, mid-9th cent.]).
